냉소바.zh_description: 冰凉荞麦面搭配清爽的日式蘸汁，口味清淡鲜香。

물비빔소바.zh_description: 荞麦面配清凉汤汁和微辣调味酱，酸爽开胃。
물비빔소바.en_description: Buckwheat noodles served with a cool broth and tangy, spicy seasoning.

비빔소바.zh_description: 荞麦面拌上酸甜微辣的酱汁，口感清爽劲道。
비빔소바.en_description: Chewy buckwheat noodles tossed in a tangy, mildly spicy sauce.

들기름소바.zh_description: 荞麦面拌上香浓紫苏油和酱油，带有清新的坚果香气。
들기름소바.en_description: Buckwheat noodles dressed with fragrant perilla oil and savory soy sauce.

판소바.zh_description: 冰镇荞麦面搭配浓郁的日式蘸汁，口味鲜香清爽。
판소바.en_description: Chilled buckwheat noodles served separately with a savory Japanese dipping sauce.

초계 냉소바.zh_description: 冰凉荞麦面配鸡肉和带醋香的清爽冷汤。
초계 냉소바.en_description: Chilled soba with chicken in a refreshing, lightly vinegared broth.

초계 물비빔소바.zh_description: 荞麦面配鸡肉、清凉汤汁和酸辣调味，酸爽开胃。
초계 물비빔소바.en_description: Buckwheat noodles with chicken, cool broth and a tangy, mildly spicy seasoning.

초계 비빔소바.zh_description: 荞麦面拌入酸爽微辣的醋芥末酱，搭配鸡肉和蔬菜。
초계 비빔소바.en_description: Buckwheat noodles tossed in a tangy, mildly spicy vinegar-mustard sauce with chicken and vegetables.

데미등심카츠.zh_description: 酥炸猪里脊淋上浓郁的多蜜酱，通常搭配卷心菜。
데미등심카츠.en_description: Crispy pork loin cutlet served with rich demi-glace sauce, usually alongside cabbage.

매운파돈카츠.zh_description: 酥炸猪排配上辛辣酱汁和葱丝。
매운파돈카츠.en_description: Crispy pork cutlet topped with spicy sauce and scallions.

더블체다카츠.zh_description: 酥炸猪排搭配双份切达芝士，口感浓郁咸香。
더블체다카츠.en_description: A crispy pork cutlet topped with double cheddar for a rich, savory flavor.

반반카츠.zh_description: 一份包含原味里脊猪排和芝士猪排，搭配酱汁与卷心菜。
반반카츠.en_description: A combination of plain pork loin cutlet and cheese cutlet, served with sauce and cabbage.

가라아게카레덮밥.zh_description: 米饭铺上酥炸鸡块，再淋上香浓日式咖喱。
가라아게카레덮밥.en_description: Rice topped with crispy Japanese-style fried chicken and savory curry sauce.

에비카레덮밥.zh_description: 米饭搭配酥炸虾和香浓咖喱酱。
에비카레덮밥.en_description: Rice served with crispy shrimp and savory curry sauce.

매콤카레카츠.zh_description: 酥炸猪排淋上带有微辣风味的浓郁咖喱酱。
매콤카레카츠.en_description: A crispy pork cutlet topped with rich, mildly spicy curry sauce.

큰부타동.zh_description: 大份米饭铺上酱香浓郁的猪肉片和洋葱。
큰부타동.en_description: A large rice bowl topped with savory soy-glazed pork and onions.

큰김치부타동.zh_description: 大份米饭搭配酱炒猪肉和酸辣泡菜。
큰김치부타동.en_description: A large rice bowl topped with savory pork and tangy stir-fried kimchi.

매운갈비덮밥.zh_description: 米饭搭配辣酱烹制的排骨和洋葱，味道浓郁。
매운갈비덮밥.en_description: Rice topped with ribs and onions cooked in a bold, spicy sauce.

카레부타동.zh_description: 米饭铺上酱炒猪肉，再淋上浓郁日式咖喱。
카레부타동.en_description: Rice topped with savory pork and rich Japanese-style curry sauce.

마제소밥 (면 대신 밥).zh_description: 米饭拌上咸香肉末酱，搭配蛋黄、葱花和海苔，风味浓郁。
마제소밥 (면 대신 밥).en_description: Rice is tossed with savory minced-meat sauce and topped with egg yolk, scallions, and seaweed.

히레카츠 (하프).zh_description: 猪里脊裹上酥脆面衣炸制，肉质柔嫩，配猪排酱食用。
히레카츠 (하프).en_description: Tender pork tenderloin is coated in crisp breadcrumbs and served with cutlet sauce.

데미히레카츠 (하프).zh_name: 半份多蜜酱菲力炸猪排
데미히레카츠 (하프).zh_description: 酥炸猪里脊搭配浓郁的多蜜酱，口感柔嫩、酱香醇厚。
데미히레카츠 (하프).en_description: Crispy pork tenderloin is served with rich, savory demi-glace sauce.

모짜치즈카츠 (2개).zh_name: 马苏里拉芝士炸猪排（2块）
모짜치즈카츠 (2개).zh_description: 猪肉裹着马苏里拉芝士炸至金黄，外脆内软、芝士浓香。
모짜치즈카츠 (2개).en_description: Pork and mozzarella are fried in a crisp coating for a crunchy outside and melty, cheesy center.

가라아게 (5개).zh_description: 鸡肉以酱油等调味后炸至外酥里嫩，咸香可口。
가라아게 (5개).en_description: Chicken is seasoned with soy-based sauce and fried until crisp outside and juicy inside.

새우튀김 (2개).zh_description: 鲜虾裹上轻薄面衣炸至酥脆，鲜甜可口。
새우튀김 (2개).en_description: Shrimp is lightly battered and fried until crisp, with a naturally sweet seafood flavor.

짜조 (2개).zh_description: 薄皮包入猪肉和蔬菜后炸至金黄，口感酥脆、馅料鲜香。
짜조 (2개).en_description: Crisp fried rolls are filled with savory pork and vegetables.

감자고로케 (4개).zh_description: 细腻土豆泥裹上面包糠炸至金黄，外酥内软。
감자고로케 (4개).en_description: Creamy mashed potato is coated in breadcrumbs and fried until golden and crisp.

닭껍질교자 (4개).zh_description: 饺子皮包入鸡皮和调味馅料，煎炸后外脆内香。
닭껍질교자 (4개).en_description: Gyoza wrappers hold a savory chicken-skin filling, cooked until crisp and flavorful.

불맛미니부타동.zh_description: 米饭铺上炙烤猪肉和洋葱，带有微甜咸香的酱汁风味。
불맛미니부타동.en_description: Rice is topped with flame-grilled pork and onions in a savory, slightly sweet sauce.

김치미니부타동.zh_description: 米饭搭配猪肉、泡菜和洋葱，咸香微辣，带有发酵酸香。
김치미니부타동.en_description: Pork, kimchi, and onions are served over rice for a savory bowl with a mild spicy kick.

미니카레밥.zh_description: 米饭淋上浓稠咖喱酱，搭配猪肉和蔬菜，味道温和香浓。
미니카레밥.en_description: Rice is served with mild, savory curry sauce, pork, and vegetables.
